# Logo images generated by tools/png_to_lvgl.py (optional).
# (ESP-IDF also runs this file in CMake "script mode", so no CONFIGURE_DEPENDS here.
#  After adding a NEW logo file, do a clean build / re-run CMake so it gets picked up.)
file(GLOB LOGO_SRCS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ui/logos/*.c" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/ui/images/*.c")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${LOGO_SRCS} "main.c"
         "lv_mem_psram.c"
         "modbus_master.c"
         "mb_poll.c"
         "mb_map.c"
         "plc/plc.c"
         "plc/program.c"
         "plc/plc_link.c"
         "plc/plc_debug.c"
         "display_driver.c"
         "board_periph.c"
         "settings.c"
         "params.c"
         "sensors.c"
         "net_time.c"
         "ui/ui_filtermode.c"
         "ui/ui_advanced.c"
         "ui/ui_analog.c"
         "ui/ui_diag.c"
         "ui/ui_splash.c"
         "ui/ui_drain.c"
         "ui/ui_param_edit.c"
         "ui/ui.c"
         "ui/ui_keypad.c"
         "ui/ui_home.c"
         "ui/ui_idle.c"
         "ui/ui_passcode.c"
         "ui/ui_menus.c"
         "ui/ui_params.c"
         "ui/ui_sequence.c"
         "ui/ui_info.c"
         "ui/ui_netcfg.c"
         "ui/ui_datetime.c"
         "ui/ui_alarms.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "." "ui" "plc"
    # Keep every object of this component: lv_mem_psram.c is only called from inside LVGL,
    # which is linked after main, so without this the linker drops it (undefined lv_malloc_core).
    WHOLE_ARCHIVE
)
